correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 (evenness): pyramid decomposition Vol(P)=sum_F Vol2(F) holds for reflexive P with facet distance 1; Pick Vol2(F)=2I_F+B_F-2 applied in facet lattice is valid; sum_F B_F = sum_F sum_{e in F} l(e) = 2*sum_{edges} l(e) is even, so Vol even. Verified step-by-step; no hidden factor error (standard height-1 pyramid formula). Lemma 2 (Vol>=4): >=4 facets each Vol2>=1 (unimodular triangle minimum) gives >=4. Correct. Spectrum logic: (a) confines any Vol<=12 reflexive volume to {4,6,8,10,12}; witnesses prove all five occur, hence attained spectrum equals that set without needing full GL classification. Valid. Witness verification: independent recomputation (separate facet enumeration, primitive normals, bbox lattice-point counts, determinant fan volumes) reproduces dists all 1, vols [4,6,8,10,12], L triples (5,15,35),(6,20,49),(7,25,63),(8,30,77),(9,35,91), h* (1,1,1,1),(1,2,2,1),(1,3,3,1),(1,4,4,1),(1,5,5,1) with sum=vol and palindromic. Replay of output/artifacts/verify_census.py exits 0 and matches verify.log/census_result.json. Ehrhart solve formulas h1=L1-4, h2=L2-10-4h1, h3=L3-20-10h1-4h2 verified against L(t)=sum h_i C(t+3-i,3). All facets in witnesses are triangles (tetrahedron/bipyramids), so volume fan triangulation is exact; float atan2 ordering in script is immaterial. Part (d): reflexive => h* palindromic (Hibi, cited) => (1,a,a,1), Vol=2+2a => a=V/2-1; all five vectors have a>=1 hence unimodal. Correctly invoked as cited theorem, distinguished from proved lemmas. Minor typo in DRAFT Sec.1 numerator (h2 x^3) does not propagate; later formulas correct. Scope honestly limited: no per-volume class counts, no inequivalence certification claimed; gap proved via parity+witnesses.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search-count: KS 3D classification (hep-th/9805190) gives 4319 counts/connectivity and 16 maximal polytopes, no sorted attained-volume spectrum, no consecutive-gap witness, no Vol<=12 Ehrhart/h* table. KS methods paper (hep-th/9512204) gives weight-system/matrix algorithm, not window distribution. Batyrev (alg-geom/9310003) gives dual-mirror construction motivation, no small-volume census. Nill-Paffenholz (1205.1270) gives general sharp upper bound (projective space maximal) and equality case, not Vol<=12 spectrum. Amendola-Oldekop (2311.13572) computes ML degrees over same 4319 and notes ML-degree gaps — different statistic (ML degree vs normalized-volume consecutive gap) and different table. Sage/PALP docs provide toolchain (built-in reflexive sequences, volume/lattice-point/polar methods), not a result. Hibi palindromicity and Pick's theorem are general tools; they imply evenness (Vol=2+2a) in general but do not publish the Vol<=12 exact spectrum {4,6,8,10,12}, maximal gap G*=2 four-way tie, or witness Ehrhart table. Existence of 4,6,8,10,12 examples requires explicit reflexive constructions (simplex; bipyramids over reflexive triangle/diamond/pentagon/hexagon) plus reflexivity certification, not mechanically read off from counts. Internal failed attempts differ: SCOPE-FAIL-20260908-045 (max volume under <=14 lattice points, gap g) uses different bounding predicate and extremum; SCOPE-FAIL-20260908-003 (full 4319 h*/IDP census) is broader unfinished survey; neither implies Vol<=12 consecutive-gap spectrum. No prior found publishes this window gap extremum.

value.rationale: Strongest headline judged separately: exact attained-volume spectrum {4,6,8,10,12} for reflexive 3-polytopes with Vol<=12, maximal consecutive gap G*=2 (four-way tie), and forced h*=(1,V/2-1,V/2-1,1) all unimodal with explicit replayable witnesses. Object (reflexive 3-polytopes) and invariant (volume spectrum/gap, h*) were motivated before computation by toric Fano/Batyrev-mirror classification and Ehrhart volume-vs-h* boundary program (Ehrhart conjecture equality case, IDP/unimodality). Value not known or mechanically implied: KS gives counts not spectrum; parity alone does not give existence of 10,12; witnesses need construction+certification. Future researcher testing small-volume boundaries or needing mirror test data can reasonably retrieve this precise fact. Narrow datum allowed: rigorously established exact invariant of natural object, not rejected merely for being one spectrum/constant/witness; no general theorem or completed GL-class census demanded. Honestly described as fallback (non-unique gap, no per-volume class counts, Hibi cited), so incomplete census does not erase headline value. Not a textbook restatement (no textbook tabulates this window spectrum), not mere parameter substitution, not tiny unmotivated gain, not unexplained enumeration (every number has vertex matrix, facet-distance/volume/Ehrhart certificate and mathematical interpretation via lemmas+Hibi). Cutoff Vol<=12 is bounded-window census form, sparse yet nontrivial, not arbitrary-object rescue.

residual_risks: Parity (evenness) also follows immediately from Hibi (Vol=2+2a), so elementary Pick proof is alternative derivation, not new general theorem; novelty rests on window spectrum + witnesses, which is narrow by design.
Vol<=12 cutoff is a bounded-window choice; admitted as natural small-volume regime but any cutoff retains some conventionality.

Part (d) relies on cited Hibi theorem, not re-proved; if citation misapplied the h* forcing would fail, but standard statement supports dim-3 reflexive palindromicity and independent witness h* cross-agree.
Verifier uses float atan2 for facet polygon ordering; harmless here (all facets triangles, independently rechecked) but not robust for general polygons.
